name: Jyotirmaya Thakur

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jyotirmaya Thakur writes poetry in English and Hindi, alongside fiction, essays and drama. A retired school educator, she is the author of Musings of a Mystic: Metaphysical Verses, published by Clever Fox in 2020, and the Hindi poetry collection Talaash.

In “When We Gather at the Rivers,” a remembered maternal hymn opens onto the Ganga, worship and the struggle to protect a place for faith. The poem moves from childhood recollection to public argument, returning finally to water and reflected aarti flames as images of an inward sanctuary.
